rebuilds the state store by replaying the local archive

Usage: dolos data rebuild [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --target <TARGET>          Rebuild into a fresh state store at this path, leaving the
                                 instance's own stores untouched
      --ephemeral                Rebuild into an in-memory state store and discard it (a validation
                                 run that writes nothing). Holds the whole ledger in RAM — pair it
                                 with --stop-epoch on a public network, or use --target instead
      --rewrite-logs             Also re-write what the archive derives from its blocks: the log
                                 records (PoolEpochLog, reward logs, EpochState, period logs) and
                                 the index entries, filling in any an older version did not index;
                                 in-place mode only
      --stop-epoch <STOP_EPOCH>  Stop cleanly once the replay reaches this epoch (requires --target
                                 or --ephemeral)
      --chunk <CHUNK>            Number of blocks to import per chunk [default: 500]
      --yes                      Go ahead with what the command destroys
  -c, --config <CONFIG>          
  -h, --help                     Print help
